summary.text: Lisa Curtis is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Nicole Chavez (R).
An attorney, she previously served in the New Mexico State Senate representing District 21.

paragraphs.text: Curtis was appointed to the New Mexico State Senate in 2012, representing District 21, and served until 2013.
She ran for the seat in the 2012 general election and lost to Republican Mark Moores, 56.6 percent to 43.4 percent.

The Albuquerque Journal reported on August 14, 2026, that Bernalillo County Democratic Party members selected Curtis, a trial attorney, to fill a ballot vacancy for House District 31 after the initial Democratic candidate withdrew and a second nominee also withdrew.
